name: Reign
source:
An adventure game set in near future where main character investigates his identity while living in sweet cohabitation with the girl "Reign" who emerged from industrial waste hard disk.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一款以近未来为舞台的冒险游戏。主角一边与从一块废弃工业硬盘中现身的少女“蕾恩”甜蜜同居，一边探寻自己的身世。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
